import unittest
from solution import build_environment


class EnvironmentDeploymentTypeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_malformed_deployment_raises_value_error_before_loader(self):
        calls = []
        config = dict(view_root='v', deployment=[], diagnostics={}, datastore={}, route_modules=[])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_environment(config, lambda names: calls.append(names) or [])
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from solution import build_environment


def handler_a():
    return "a"


def handler_b():
    return "b"


class BuildEnvironmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_builds_ordered_independent_environment(self):
        config = {
            "view_root": "/views",
            "deployment": "staging",
            "diagnostics": {"levels": ["warn"]},
            "datastore": {"nodes": [{"host": "db"}]},
            "route_modules": ["users", "health"],
            "extra": {"ignored": True},
        }
        loader_args = []
        loader_result = [("/users", handler_a), ("/health", handler_b)]

        def loader(names):
            loader_args.append(names)
            self.assertIsNot(names, config["route_modules"])
            return loader_result

        result = build_environment(config, loader)
        self.assertEqual(loader_args, [["users", "health"]])
        self.assertEqual(result, {
            "view_root": "/views", "deployment": "staging",
            "diagnostics": {"levels": ["warn"]},
            "datastore": {"nodes": [{"host": "db"}]},
            "routes": [("/users", handler_a), ("/health", handler_b)],
        })
        result["diagnostics"]["levels"].append("debug")
        result["datastore"]["nodes"][0]["host"] = "changed"
        result["routes"].append(("/extra", handler_a))
        self.assertEqual(config["diagnostics"], {"levels": ["warn"]})
        self.assertEqual(config["datastore"], {"nodes": [{"host": "db"}]})
        self.assertEqual(loader_result, [("/users", handler_a), ("/health", handler_b)])

    def test_empty_routes(self):
        config = {"view_root": "v", "deployment": "development",
                  "diagnostics": {}, "datastore": {}, "route_modules": []}
        calls = []
        result = build_environment(config, lambda names: calls.append(names) or [])
        self.assertEqual(calls, [[]])
        self.assertEqual(result["routes"], [])

    def test_bad_config_never_calls_loader(self):
        base = {"view_root": "v", "deployment": "production",
                "diagnostics": {}, "datastore": {}, "route_modules": ["m"]}
        variants = [None, {}, {**base, "view_root": ""},
                    {**base, "deployment": "test"},
                    {**base, "diagnostics": []}, {**base, "datastore": []},
                    {**base, "route_modules": "m"},
                    {**base, "route_modules": [""]},
                    {**base, "route_modules": ["m", "m"]}]
        for bad in variants:
            calls = []
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_environment(bad, lambda names: calls.append(names) or [])
                self.assertEqual(calls, [])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_environment(base, 7)

    def test_bad_loader_results(self):
        config = {"view_root": "v", "deployment": "production",
                  "diagnostics": {}, "datastore": {}, "route_modules": ["m"]}
        bad_results = [None, (), [("/x", handler_a, 1)],
                       [("", handler_a)], [("/x", 3)],
                       [("/x", handler_a), ("/x", handler_b)]]
        for bad in bad_results:
            calls = []
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    build_environment(config, lambda names, b=bad: calls.append(names) or b)
                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
